接下来几天，王建新的日子又恢复了往常的节奏。修炼、巡逻、放羊，一天一天地过。太阳升起来，太阳落下去，草原上的日子慢得像河水一样，不急不躁。

但他心里总惦记着一件事。

“这次怎么不得给个一等功、二等功？”王建新盘腿坐在河边，一边运转功法一边琢磨。上次抓了六个，给了个三等功。这次抓了三十多个，救了一个同志，还帮另外两个哨点解了围，功劳比上次大了不知道多少倍。按说，怎么也得给个一等功吧？

“具体能给个什么也无所谓了。”王建新想了想，又觉得自己想多了。给什么功是上面的事，他想也没用。

但他预感到，怕是在这待不了太长时间了。

出了这么大的事，三个哨点被袭击，一个巡边员牺牲，上面肯定会有动作。加强边防力量，增加人手，或者调整部署——不管怎么弄，他这个小哨点都不可能再像以前那样一个人待着了。

“得提前准备准备。”

王建新琢磨了一下，决定再去那边搞几只羊，再弄一匹马。

他和大青马有感情了。大青马跟了他一年了，从从哨点到蒙古、到苏联、到土耳其，跑了上万里路。现在大青马在空间里养得特别好，毛色发亮，膘肥体壮，跑起来跟一阵风似的。他不舍得把它留在这儿。

空间里的那些马，每一匹都养得好好的，他也不舍得留下。但交接的时候不好解释。他得搞一匹普通的马，留在外面充数。

羊也是一样。空间里的羊肉带着淡淡的灵气，一吃就能吃出来不一样。总不能到最后移交的时候，赶着七只羊走吧？

“得换一批普通的。”

当天晚上，王建新等天彻底黑了，再次潜入蒙古。

这次他没往远处跑，就在附近找了个牧民点。离边境不远，骑着马跑了不到一个小时就到了。牧民点不大，几个蒙古包，牛羊圈挨在一起。狗叫了几声，被风一吹就没了。

王建新摸黑靠近羊圈，挑了几只和他的羊差不多大小的——个头差不多，毛色差不多，看着就是普通的蒙古羊。他收了七只，放进空间。

然后又摸到马圈，挑了一匹和他大青马长得很像的——个头差不多，毛色一样，也是青色的。他看了看那匹马的牙口，年轻，四五岁，正是好时候。

“就你了。”王建新把那匹马收入空间。

他看了看圈里剩下的牛羊，想了想，干脆多收一些。来都来了，不多收点对不起自己。

他偷悄悄地又收了一百多只羊、二十多头黄牛。羊群和牛群在空间里安安静静地站着，不叫不闹。奶牛和马他没收，牛奶喝也喝不完，马他空间里已经有十几匹了，够用了。

收完了，王建新愉快地返回了他的哨点。

进了空间，他把七只新收的羊和一匹新收的马单独放在一边，跟自己原来的羊群和马群分开。原来的那七只羊，他留在了空间里，不打算放到外面去了。原来的大青马，他也留在空间里，以后自己骑着。

出了空间，他把新收的七只羊和一匹马放出来，赶到羊圈和马棚里。羊们到了新环境，有点不适应，咩咩叫了几声，就安静了。马打了个响鼻，甩了甩尾巴，低头吃草。

王建新看了看，满意地点了点头。

“行了，交接的时候不怕了。”

他回到空间，继续修炼。灵气在体内运转，一圈一圈的，炼气四层的门槛就在眼前，但就是迈不过去。

这次想象的军功，等了一个多星期也没等来。

王建新开始还有点惦记，天天等着步谈机响，等着吉普车来。一天，两天，三天……一个星期过去了，什么动静也没有。他也就慢慢不再想这些事情了。

时间来到六月底。

In the next few days, Wang Jianxin's life returned to its usual rhythm.Practicing, patrolling, herding sheep, living day by day.The sun rises and sets, and the days on the grassland are as slow as river water, neither impatient nor impatient.

But there was always one thing on his mind.

"Why can't we give first-class and second-class merit this time?" Wang Jianxin sat cross-legged by the river, thinking about it while running the technique.Last time I caught six of them and gave them third-class merit.This time we arrested more than 30 people, rescued a comrade, and helped two other sentinel points get out of the siege. The credit is many times greater than last time.Ordinarily, I have to give him first-class merit no matter what, right?

"It doesn't matter what I can give you." Wang Jianxin thought about it and felt that he was thinking too much.It is useless for him to think about what kind of merit he should give.

But he had a premonition that he might not be able to stay here for too long.

With such a big incident happening, three sentry posts being attacked, and a lineman being sacrificed, there will definitely be some action from above.Strengthen border defense, increase manpower, or adjust deployment - no matter what you do, this small outpost can no longer be left alone like before.

"You have to prepare in advance."

Wang Jianxin thought about it and decided to go there to get a few more sheep and a horse.

He has feelings for Daqingma.Daqingma has been following him for a year, traveling thousands of miles from the sentry post to Mongolia, the Soviet Union, and Turkey.Now the big green horse has been raised particularly well in the space. Its coat is shiny, fat and strong, and it can run like a gust of wind.He couldn't bear to leave it here.

Each of the horses in the space was well-raised, and he was not willing to keep them.But it was difficult to explain during the handover.He had to get an ordinary horse and keep it outside to make up for it.

The same goes for sheep.The mutton in the space has a touch of aura, and you can taste the difference as soon as you eat it.You can't just drive away seven sheep at the final handover time, right?

"It has to be replaced with a batch of ordinary ones."

That night, Wang Jianxin waited until it was completely dark before sneaking into Mongolia again.

This time he did not run far away, but found a herdsman's spot nearby.It's not far from the border, and it took less than an hour to ride on horseback.The herdsmen's camp is not big, just a few yurts and cattle and sheep pens next to each other.The dog barked a few times, but was blown away by the wind.

Wang Jianxin approached the sheepfold in the dark and picked out a few sheep that were about the same size as his - similar in size and similar in coat color. They looked like ordinary Mongolian sheep.He collected seven of them and put them into the space.

Then he touched the horse pen and picked out a horse that looked very similar to his big green horse - almost the same size, with the same coat color, also green.He looked at the horse's teeth. It was young, four or five years old, and it was just the right time.

"It's up to you." Wang Jianxin put the horse into the space.

He looked at the remaining cattle and sheep in the pen, and after thinking about it, he might as well collect more.It’s already here, I’d be sorry if I didn’t charge more.

He secretly collected more than 100 sheep and more than 20 oxen.The sheep and cattle stood quietly in the space, neither barking nor making any noise.He confiscated the cows and horses, and he couldn't finish the milk. He already had more than a dozen horses in his space, which was enough.

After collecting it, Wang Jianxin happily returned to his sentry post.

Entering the space, he put the seven newly harvested sheep and one newly collected horse aside alone, separate from his original flock of sheep and horses.He kept the original seven sheep in the space and did not intend to put them outside.He also kept the original big green horse in the space and rode it by himself in the future.

When there was room, he released the seven newly collected sheep and a horse and rushed them to the sheepfold and stable.When the sheep arrived in the new environment, they felt a little uncomfortable. They bleated a few times and then became quiet.The horse snorted, flicked its tail, and lowered its head to eat grass.

Wang Jianxin looked at it and nodded with satisfaction.

"Okay, don't be afraid when handing over."

He returned to space and continued to practice.The spiritual energy circulates in the body, going round and round. The threshold of the fourth level of Qi Refining is right in front of us, but I just can't cross it.

This time I had to wait for more than a week for the imaginary military glory to come, but it still didn't come.

Wang Jianxin was still a little worried about it at first, waiting for the walkie-talkie to ring and the jeep to arrive every day.One day, two days, three days... a week passed, but nothing happened.He gradually stopped thinking about these things.

The time comes to the end of June.
